description: Turn a compiled blueprintId into a persistent, fully editable Picorn editor file (native text, shape and image layers through the editor importer), render every slide and return the editorUrl, render URLs and a contact sheet. With a Picorn access token the file lands in your account and can be linked to a campaign idea (campaignId + ideaId) and scheduled with picorn_posts_schedule.

allowErrors.description: Create the file although the last compile still reports errors. Default false.

caption.description: Post caption stored on the file and used when scheduling.

name: picorn_blueprint_create_file
title: Picorn Blueprint: create the editor file
